sourceNote: Adapted from Y Combinator's Requests for Startups, crypto category. Re-cast for Sui where the original was chain-agnostic. Drops L2 scaling, ZK rollups, and EVM MEV themes (irrelevant to Sui).

ideas.title: Tools for the agent economy
ideas.summary: Identity, payments, contracts, and disputes for AI agents transacting with other agents and humans.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's capability model expresses agent authority natively; sponsored tx removes gas friction in agent flows.
ideas.marketSignal: YC has run multiple agent-focused batches; agent-to-agent payments is a stated theme.

ideas.title: Creator monetization beyond ads
ideas.summary: Direct fan support, gated content, royalty splits, all on chain. Stripe-grade UX.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores content cheaply, Sui objects model royalty splits, zkLogin removes wallet friction.
ideas.marketSignal: Creator economy ($100B+) recurring YC theme; web3 attempts have been UX-blocked.

ideas.title: Data marketplaces with verifiable access
ideas.summary: Buyers pay on chain, sellers grant capability-scoped access, both sides have audit trails.
ideas.fitForSui: Capabilities express scoped access; Walrus stores datasets; Sui settles payments.
ideas.marketSignal: Data marketplace startups appear in multiple YC RFS rounds; AI training fuels demand.

ideas.title: Consumer credit with on-chain repayment
ideas.summary: BNPL or revolving credit where repayment is enforced via Move logic, not just contract law.
ideas.fitForSui: Capabilities scope which transactions count toward repayment; sponsored gas hides crypto.
ideas.marketSignal: Consumer credit is a perennial YC RFS; on-chain enforcement is the missing primitive.

ideas.title: Portable on-chain reputation
ideas.summary: Reputation that travels across apps, scoped by capability, refusable by the user.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects carry reputation state directly; capability-scoped reads protect privacy.
ideas.marketSignal: Reputation is a known YC theme; existing solutions are silo-locked or off-chain.

ideas.title: Stablecoin remittance for emerging markets
ideas.summary: Send USDC across borders. Off-ramp via local partners. Verifiable on chain, invisible UX.
ideas.fitForSui: Native USDC on Sui plus sponsored tx removes the wallet step that blocks adoption.
ideas.marketSignal: Remittance is a $700B annual market; stablecoin share is climbing fast.

ideas.title: Supply-chain provenance with verifiable trace
ideas.summary: Each step in a supply chain emits a Sui object. Buyers and regulators verify the chain end-to-end.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model carries the trace per-item, not in a global table. Cheap to scale.
ideas.marketSignal: ESG and provenance regulation is tightening globally; existing solutions rely on trust.

ideas.title: Verifiable SaaS usage billing
ideas.summary: B2B SaaS where every billable event lands on chain. Buyer audits, regulator trusts.
ideas.fitForSui: Sponsored tx hides crypto from SaaS users; Sui's throughput supports per-event records.
ideas.marketSignal: SaaS billing transparency is an unmet need in enterprise procurement.
